pages.title: Titan's Hidden Ocean
pages.text: $(thing)Titan's Hidden Ocean$()$(br2)Under a hundred kilometres of ice, Titan hides an ocean of salty water, larger than all of Earth's. Unlocks the Cryobot that melts down into it, and the ecosystem round its vents.

$(thing)Insight$(): 220$(br2)$(thing)Builds on$(): Titan, Ecology.$(br2)$(thing)Samples$(): 16 Water-Ice Bedrock, 1 Stable Ecosystem.$(br2)$(thing)Derivation$(): Under a layer of ice of density r and thickness h, on a world whose surface gravity is g, write the load P the ice puts on each square metre of the ocean below.
